purpose: Define a read-only, full-spectrum, indexed-lazy memory routing contract that exposes all memory classes through bounded task routing without eager-loading or duplicating the corpus and without mutating canonical Identity, Personality, Governance or Approved Memory.
zero_downtime_invariants: Track-A continues while memory index adapter operates in read-only Track-B shadow mode.
Step-003 must not reset mission_id, step_id, pending packet/hash, role or lease merely because the memory adapter fails.
No new formal worker or slot is created; formal slots remain LCR-A/LCR-B/LCR-C.
Only compact manifests, provenance and evidence pointers cross tracks; raw full-context merge is forbidden.
formal_builder_acceptance: Fresh-read this candidate plus authoritative Step-003 packet and current branch bytes.
Builder may adopt, modify or reject this candidate but must independently reproduce tests.
Create the formal contract only from the LCR-B role under the current authorized packet.
Run Core v0.2 and memory adapter regressions.
Produce BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED evidence only after all Step-003 allowed artifacts exist and tests pass.
Consume A-to-B packet exactly once and create exactly one B-to-C packet only after Builder acceptance is complete.
independent_verifier_acceptance: Re-read exact formal contract and adapter bytes/hash independently.
Verify deterministic manifest and exact dedupe semantics.
Verify L0 bootstrap order and task-routed L1-L4 lazy loading.
Verify ALL/FULL eager-load attempts are rejected.
Verify protected/ambiguous/contradictory sources quarantine and cannot direct-promote.
Verify candidate failure leaves primary mission and live protected domains unchanged.
Verify no model download, training, package install, spend, main/default write, secret persistence or slot4 occurred.
claim_boundary: This is a non-formal Quantum research candidate. Its presence does not satisfy the Step-003 Builder acceptance, does not consume a formal packet, and is not a C PASS.
